svg.title: Drizzlet hidden options guide
svg.desc: Three pages of mix knob settings with quality LED [A] colour and blink indications. Full text version in OPTIONS.md.

g.text: 2. Change page: tap [M]. The pulsing mix
3. Change a setting: turn its knob. It
saves by itself (the page LED flashes).
4. Close: hold [M] 3 seconds, or press any
other button except SEED [C] on page 1 with
Scale selected: short taps step the scale.
Move a knob a little before it responds.
Wait a moment before powering off.
on: it resets all settings to
set, [M] can route CV to it
for about a second and a
half to start or stop it.
